name: Pip
subtitle: Pip, the money tracker with a coin mascot
description: Add this source to install Pip and get its updates.

apps.name: Pip
apps.subtitle: Track spending with Pip
apps.localizedDescription: Log what you spend in seconds, keep a daily streak, and see where your money goes. Pip cheers you on.
apps.versionDescription: Money you actually have: set what you start with, add income (work, parents, gifts, extra money), and see how much you can spend per day until payday. Payday check-ins ask if your money arrived. Bills and subscriptions are added on their day with a heads-up the day before. Savings goals, edit any entry, search history, browse past months in Insights, export to CSV, Face ID lock and a currency picker.
